title: Isolate authenticated ledger reconciliation repairs from P104 research
body:
## Scope

Isolate 11 shared ledger/reconciliation repair files from #3577, retaining the exact existing patch for review. Exact head: `1f360c63d00289aa5be2300d8c72e7bcf86827fe`.

- Authenticate three original intake snapshots by commit, Git blob and SHA256; preserve first-seen contributor/head metadata instead of inferring it from mutable current rows
- Preserve closure presence/value projection; the current ledger delta is exactly 19 missing closure keys becoming explicit null, with all 3,028 rows and other metadata unchanged
- Admit only the explicitly pinned documentation/helper successors; preserve historical source hashes and rejection controls
- Keep community-tooling diagnostics and subsequent regression/mutation checks available after failure, while preserving failure exit status

No full ledger regeneration was performed. The separate historical receipt adapter extraction is independent of this patch.

## Bounded validation

Python 3.12.14: 15 focused intake/closure controls pass normally and 15 pass under optimized Python; all changed Python parses. The exact documentation-successor positive and mutation/rejection control passes in normal and optimized mode. actionlint 1.7.12 accepts community-tooling799.yml (optional shellcheck/pyflakes disabled).

The full test_pr_reconciliation.py attempt was incomplete in the sparse checkout: it exited with missing historical fixture files, not a passing suite (34 tests invoked, 28 errors including setup/subtests). No historical mathematical replay or selected-frontier replay was run. The source #3577 exact head has successful Community exact tooling and Historical reconciliation 92 runs, but that is prior combined-head evidence. Fresh exact-extraction CI is now recorded below.

Reproduce targeted checks:
```sh
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_pr_reconciliation.py -v
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_historical_check.py -k ci_document_successor -v
python3 -B -O -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_historical_check.py -k ci_document_successor -v
```

## Consolidation and boundaries

Extracted byte-for-byte from the shared repair portion of #3577 at `3088a09c77fe5353218df861e34b0fe67dbf1b6b`, independently based on canonical `bb4bccbf42844d2801487450727c2f63e10d1d0f`. The dedicated P112 parse repair remains in #3885; no duplicate P112 change is bundled here. The 11 P104 scientific files are absent. Existing research branch heads remain untouched until maintainers incorporate an effective shared base. No upstream merge, force-push, source repinning, selected-result update or scientific acceptance is proposed.

Current AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, autoresearch.md and linked procedure were read. Delta-only intake refresh fetched canonical main but could not authenticate its gh CLI queue read; exact-head GitHub connector reads supplied targeted status instead. This is an explicit user-assigned repair, not a queue review or ledger acceptance decision.

## Credit and limitations

Existing source authors, original repair attribution and Apache-2.0 notices are retained. Consolidation by Clear1nsight with substantial OpenAI assistance. Green checks validate only their stated coverage, not the multiplication theorem or current scientific approval. Draft pending independent substantive tooling review. Canonical main still contains the inherited P112 parse problem until #3885 is incorporated; an inherited zero-job fork failure must not be mistaken for failure of the scoped tests.


## Fresh exact-head CI (2026-10-19 UTC)

At `1f360c63d00289aa5be2300d8c72e7bcf86827fe`, all three scoped fork workflows completed successfully:
- [Community exact tooling and scoped audits](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39321054770), including full historical regression, reconciliation tests normally and optimized, ledger/archive integrity and tracked-file mutation gate
- [r420-two-sided-basis](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39321055035), Python 3.11 and 3.13
- [Historical reconciliation 92 integrity](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39321055083)

The separate [P112 configuration failure](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39321052618) has zero jobs and is inherited from canonical main pending #3885. It is not silently counted as passing.
